root_cause: Commercial Mastercard credit transactions are being downgraded to higher-cost consumer interchange rates due to missing Level 2/3 commercial card data.
diagnosis: The fee charged (Rs 1,201.01) exceeds the expected fee (Rs 857.86) by Rs 343.15 on a Rs 42,893.20 transaction, indicating the gateway is applying a higher interchange rate because the transaction lacks the L2/L3 data required to qualify for the lower commercial card rate. Note: This comparison uses a modeled benchmark as the source status is illustrative.
action_rationale: Providing Level 2/3 commercial card data will allow the gateway to correctly classify the transaction and apply the lower commercial interchange rate, eliminating the fee overcharge.
